title: Orthogonal polynomials on path-space
summary: We consider the orthogonalisation of the signature of a stochastic process as the analogue of orthogonal polynomials on path-space. Under an infinite radius of convergence assumption, we prove density of linear functions on the signature in $L^p$ functions on grouplike elements, making it possible to represent a square-integrable function on (rough) paths as an $L^2$-convergent series.
